# Scythe

Internal ID: Scythe | Type: Tool | Source: Forge | Usage: Farming | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Silver x10

# Introduction

The Scythe is a tool used to harvest crops. It cannot be used as a weapon.

## Upgrade information

• stat: Durability | Quality 1: 200 | Quality 2: 400 | Quality 3: 600

• stat: Crafting recipe | Quality 1: Scythe handle x1Silver x6 | Quality 2: Silver x5 | Quality 3: Silver x10

• stat: Workbench level | Quality 1: 2 | Quality 2: 3 | Quality 3: 4

## Notes

• Farming (Skill) decreases scythe stamina consumption and increases its range.
• Scythe does not work on Jotun puffs and Magecap.
• If used on an enemy, it will cause no damage, however, it will still give Farming experience.
